input_fields.name: output_role
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `role` and `filename_or_pattern`; the path name must be explicit rather than guessed.

input_fields.name: run_directory
input_fields.description: The explicit run directory under which the output path is to be declared.

input_fields.name: overwrite_policy
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `collision`, `protected_paths`, and `replacement`; it declares policy without performing writes.

input_fields.name: known_paths
input_fields.description: Array of path objects, each with required keys `path`, `role`, and `protected`, used only for collision checks.

result_fields.name: output_path_binding
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `role`, `path_or_expression`, `run_directory`, `overwrite_policy`, and `writes_performed`; nullable when the common output envelope records incomplete path policy.

result_fields.name: collision_check
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `contained`, `collides`, `protected`, and `decision`; it reports lexical checks without probing or changing the filesystem.

procedure: Validate the explicit run directory, one output role, and supplied filename or path pattern without creating or probing files.
Resolve the path lexically under the run directory and reject traversal, protected baseline paths, and ambiguous absolute escapes.
Compare the declared path with known paths and apply the supplied overwrite policy as a plan, not as a filesystem action.
Return `output_path_binding` and `collision_check` as action data with `writes_performed=false`, using the common output envelope for status, provenance ownership, and unresolved path policy.
rejection_rules: Reject missing or guessed filenames, path traversal, ambiguous roots, and any path outside the declared run directory.
Reject a collision with a protected baseline or another role unless the supplied policy explicitly and safely resolves it.
Paths declare destinations only: never create, overwrite, delete, move, or otherwise write files in this operation.
